name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — 3 Advanced — Night of the Red Heart

system.description: Chanting continuously through an entire night over a sample of your victim's blood and a hand-carved effigy, you fill your target with a dreadful, unmistakable premonition that this ritual means to destroy him — and unless he flees the rite's roughly 30-mile range or hunts down and stops you first, he crumbles to Final Death the instant the ritual completes at sunrise. Casting requires the expenditure of a Willpower Trait to maintain through the night, and any interruption causes it to fail outright.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
system.bloodCost: A sample of the victim's blood
